name: Evidences - Upload, view, and manage field evidence
description: Verifies evidence management: upload photos, categorize, view in gallery, and attach to orders

planSteps.description: Assert that evidences page loads with filter options (by order, date range, category) and gallery/list view toggle
Upload a test image file using the upload button and fill in metadata (description, category, order association)
Assert that the uploaded evidence appears in the gallery with correct thumbnail and metadata
Click on an evidence item to open full-screen view with zoom capability
Assert that the evidence detail shows all metadata: upload date, uploader, order ID, category
Test the evidence report generation feature
Assert that report is generated with selected evidence images and metadata
